fields.description: Configure internal model reasoning support and overrides.
fields.label: Reasoning Capabilities (Optional)

fields.description: Check to force reasoning support on for this model (overriding automatic LiteLLM detection).
fields.label: Supports Reasoning

fields.description: Optional JSON object to override reasoning capabilities (e.g. supports_thinking_blocks, supported_efforts).
fields.label: Reasoning Configuration Override (JSON)

fields.description: Enable custom prices to override LiteLLM's automatic pricing lookup. When disabled, LiteLLM's built-in price table is used as fallback. Values are in USD per 1 million tokens.
fields.label: Pricing
Enable Custom Pricing
fields.description: Check this to activate the custom prices below. When unchecked, LiteLLM's automatic pricing is used regardless of what is entered below.

fields.label: Input Cost per 1M Tokens (USD)
fields.description: Cost in USD per 1 million prompt/input tokens. E.g. enter 2.50 for $2.50 per 1M tokens. Enter 0 for free/self-hosted models.

fields.label: Output Cost per 1M Tokens (USD)
fields.description: Cost in USD per 1 million completion/output tokens. E.g. enter 10.00 for $10.00 per 1M tokens.

fields.label: Cached Input Cost per 1M Tokens (USD)
fields.description: Optional. Cost for prompt cache reads (cache hits) in USD per 1M tokens. E.g. Anthropic charges $0.30/1M for cache reads vs $3.00/1M for regular input. Leave as 0 if not applicable.

fields.label: Chat Capability Overrides
fields.description: Force these chat capabilities off for every agent using this model, regardless of each agent's own setting — useful for small/local models where the extra prompt instructions or tools would waste context.

fields.label: Disable Ask User
fields.description: Force off the ask_user structured-question tool for agents using this model.

fields.label: Disable Rich Elements
fields.description: Force off chart/HTML/SVG/mermaid/media rich-element instructions for agents using this model.

fields.label: Disable Document Artifacts
fields.description: Force off document-artifact authoring/export/redline for agents using this model.
